MEMORANDUM
TO:
Mayor Richard Kaysen, and City Council
FROM:
Sara Vasquez, Purchasing Manager
DATE:
August 19,2015
SUBJECT: Consideration of Bid #S-4-16 for annual contracts for Snow Removal and Other
Services.
Bids were requested for snow removal and other services(unforeseen emergency situations
such as demolition and cleanup necessitated by tornado or flood) to be provided on an as-
needed basis.The invitation to bid anticipated that all responsive bidders will be awarded
contracts, with the work first being assigned tothebidder submitting the lowest combination of
prices for any particular group of equipment needed for a specific situation; the, if additional
services are required, other bidders will be called upon in order of lowest bid price
combinations.
One bid was received: JTL Group Inc., d/b/a Knife River, Cheyenne, WY.
It is r4ecommended that the contract be awarded to JTL Group Inc., d/b/a Knife River for
these services.Copies of the equipment lists and bid prices are attached to the agreements.
Funding for emergency snow removal has been budgeted in the 2015-20181% sales tax.
